title: Noka e Senotseng Lipelo
intro: Nahana ka lebotho le tsamaeang, le nyoriloe 'me le lekoa, moo taelo e le 'ngoe lebopong la noka e tla arola boikemisetso le takatso. Moetapele ea khethiloeng o tataisa mabotho ho ea ho sera se matla, a tšepile Allah feela.
clues: Ke ile ka khethoa ke Allah hore ke be moetapele oa Bana ba Iseraele ka mor'a hore ba kōpe e mong ea tla loana ka tsela ea Hae.
Ke filoe bongata ba tsebo le boholo e le pontšo ea khetho ea ka, leha batho ba ka ba ne ba belaella matla a ka.
Ke ile ka tloha le mabotho 'me ka a bolella hore Allah o tla a leka ka noka.
Ke ile ka lemosa hore mang kapa mang ea noang ho eona ka bolokolohi e ke ke ea e-ba oa ka, haese ea khang letsoho.
Ke ile ka tšela le ba seng bakae ba ileng ba lula ba tiile, ba tobane le lebotho le leholo haholo ka palo.
Ke ile ka etella pele ba neng ba re ke hangata hakae sehlopha se senyenyane se hlolang se seholo ka tumello ea Allah, pele Jalut a hlōloa.

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Ho robala lehaheng ka lilemo tse ngata
Ho leka lebotho ka noka pele ho ntoa
Ho metsoa ke tlhapi e kholo
trial.answer: Ho leka lebotho ka noka pele ho ntoa

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: Phetoho ho ba litšoene bakeng sa tlōlo ea molao
Tšenyo ka ho phatloha ho matla
Tlhōlo ka tumello ea Allah 'me Jalut a bolaoa ke Dawud
outcome.answer: Tlhōlo ka tumello ea Allah 'me Jalut a bolaoa ke Dawud

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
